headline: Record quarterly earnings on wider interest margin

drivers.explanation: Higher loan yield (3 bps) and loan balances (+$36.1M average), plus higher investment yield and balances, partly offset by lower deposits at other institutions.
Net interest income growth, with a small credit-loss recovery versus a provision last quarter; non-interest expenses were $40.9M, up $2.6M y/y on salaries and benefits.

summary_short: City Holding earned $34.6M, or a record $2.43 per diluted share, as net interest margin widened to 4.04% from 3.97% last quarter.
summary_long: Net interest income rose 3.0% q/q to $62.6M. Credit quality was stable with nonperforming assets at 0.24% of loans and a $0.1M credit-loss recovery. Loans grew $48.4M to $4.55B. Return on assets was 2.03%. The bank's CET1 ratio was 15.5%. The board raised the quarterly dividend 15% to $1.00 per share. No numeric guidance was given.
confidence_notes: CET1 ratio of 15.5% is for City National Bank (the subsidiary). Y/y EPS comparison is $2.43 vs $2.41 diluted.
